# spytial-gdl

> A small graph description language for live, draggable diagrams with explicit spatial requirements.

Use spytial-gdl for graph-shaped diagrams where relationships, types, classes,
and spatial rules should remain available as source—not merely as pixels.

## Start here

- Agent instructions: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/AGENTS.md
- Introduction: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/#/introduction
- Notation: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/#/notation
- Annotations: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/#/annotations
- Embedding and API: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/#/embedding
- Platform recipes: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/#/platforms
- Playground: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/playground/
- Examples: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/examples/
- Source: https://github.com/sidprasad/spytial-gdl

## Minimal integration

Add this script to the page that renders Markdown:

    <script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/spytial-gdl/src/auto.js"></script>

Then use fenced blocks with the `spytial-gdl` language identifier. The complete
authoring and migration guidance is in AGENTS.md.
